observations: Photo 0 shows a large industrial machine with a teal and white painted frame, a metal conveyor belt, and a complex mechanical structure with rollers and guides. The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area with a concrete floor and a man standing in the background.

Photo 1 shows a closer view of the same machine, focusing on the control panel, which has buttons, a red emergency stop button, and a yellow warning sign. The machine has a transparent plastic cover over the upper section, likely for material handling. The control panel is mounted on a white cabinet with a black handle and a small window.
The machine has visible wear and tear: rust on the metal parts, dirt on the floor, and some paint chipping on the teal sections. The overall condition appears used and possibly non-functional.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine in either photo. The watermark 'OYOLAKFOM NIG LTD POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both images.

claims.evidence: The machine appears used and shows signs of wear and rust. No proof of operation is visible. The claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden mechanical or electrical faults.
risks.proof: A close-up of the control panel wiring, motor, and internal mechanisms, or a video of the machine running under load.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing critical components or parts.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo showing all parts, including the motor, belts, and any accessories.

proof_requests: Video of the machine operating, showing conveyor belt movement and control panel response.
Close-up of the control panel wiring and motor.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
